note: Per-language starting budgets for the corpus evaluation runner (issue #25). Initial values are sized generously from a real local run on 2026-08-18 (macOS/arm64, release build; see RESULTS.md): observed cold-index wall times were 0.19-1.75 s, peak RSS 120-591 MiB, warm-noop barriers 0.06-0.10 s. Budgets are ~25-100x those observations, so they trip on order-of-magnitude regressions (e.g. an accidental full reindex behind a warm barrier), not on machine noise. The typescript entry was added on 2026-08-19 from the pinned microsoft/vscode run on the same machine: observed cold-index wall ~7.7 s, peak RSS ~2.6 GiB, warm-noop barrier ~0.53 s (12.8k-file worktree scan), so its budgets are ~30x wall, ~3x RSS (matching the php RSS policy), and ~55x warm-noop; the run is legitimately degraded by the 128 MiB workspace source-byte budget (148 MiB of TypeScript sources), which the edit scenarios tolerate as recorded budget-boundary churn. Tightening a budget or changing a baseline requires review and a deliberate commit.
